results.title: Research and Development Chef
results.description: As the Research and Development Chef at Maya Kaimal Foods, you will work alongside the Product Development Chef and Chief Culinary Officer as part of the Culinary team. You will develop recipes in the R&D kitchen in Rhinebeck, New York, and work with our manufacturers to commercialize them, traveling to the factories as needed. You will collaborate closely with our Operations and Quality departments, sourcing new ingredients, reviewing packaging, and exploring new manufacturing processes. Our current portfolio has FDA and USDA products including: hot fill acidified simmer sauces, retort beans (dals and chanas) and rice, and tetra packed soups. If you are passionate about food and the science behind it, are a good communicator and are both an analytical and creative thinker, then we would love to hear from you! An interest in Indian or other global cuisines is a definite plus. This is an excellent opportunity for a candidate who is interested in working with a dedicated team at a fast-paced growing company with products in multiple categories. The preceding functions have been provided as examples of the types of work performed by employees assigned to this job classification. Requirements: To be successful, the ideal candidate should possess the following education, skills and experience: Degree in Culinary Arts or Food Science, or Culinology degree, or CRC-Certified Research ChefComputer skills (Word, Excel, PPT)Ability to problem-solve effectively and adapt to a quickly changing work environmentGood organizational skills and attention to detailActive member of IFT, RCA or similar Chef’s Association is a plusFamiliarity with FDA and USDA regulations for labeling is a plusCPG experience is a plusAbility to travel to manufacturing facilities (travel 10%) Attractions: Competitive compensation package including equity, health insurance and a 401(k) plan with company matchOpportunity for future career growth, networking, and exposure to senior CPG and PE professionalsBecome an integral part of an organization that is positioned, financed and energized for growthHelp establish Maya Kaimal Foods as THE Category Leader in modernizing South Asian cuisineBe part of a collaborative, entrepreneurial culture with cross functional input

results.description: POSITION SUMMARY: The Account Manager provides sales and service support to an existing customer base and prospect and sales development to new industrial food & beverage accounts. The main focus will be on retaining business through troubleshooting and technical guidance. This individual's technical expertise will be used to identify correct chemical dosing and applications for specific procedures, troubleshoot product and application problems, and identify the correct resources required to diagnose and solve issues at customer accounts. The job requires the candidate to recommend solutions to improve sanitation and operation procedures at our customer locations and prospect and develop new sales. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: Servicing accounts - plant chemical management, sanitation program review, training on safety, chemical use concentrations, trouble shooting on cleaning issues, identify plant operational savings in water, energy and labor, Business Development/Sales – cold calls, prospecting, survey/audits, presentations, Account profitability review, review of products sold to accounts on an ongoing basis. Time Management for monthly service and reporting, presentation skills. Office support i.e. email and phone communications, report writing, and continuing account manager education. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS: Bachelor's degree in Food, Dairy, or Meat Science, Microbiology, Biology, Chemistry, and/or Life Sciences preferred. Extensive experience in food manufacturing operations with high school diploma in lieu of BA will be considered. Specialty chemical sales relative to the Food and Beverage customer base 5+ years of experience in food, dairy, and/or beverage manufacturing plant in a management level position. 5+ years of experience with: Email, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Gmail Ability to travel overnight up to 60% Valid US Driver’s License Good understanding of Clean-In-Place (CIP) in food, beverage, and dairy operation(s). Ability to work flexible hours (nights and weekends) to accommodate cleaning operations and preventative maintenance schedules within plants. Ability to work in an industrial plant environment and remain compliant with all company and customer plant, safety, and OSHA requirements. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills (written and spoken) with ability to interact with all levels of the organization. High sense of drive and urgency with a positive outlook. SALARY AND BENEFITS: The current pay range for this position is $72,000 - $97,000.
